title: Frank-Wolfe with Moreau Envelope Smoothing for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Problems
summary: We present and analyze Frank-Wolfe with Moreau Envelope Smoothing (FRAMES) for solving nonsmooth nonconvex constrained optimization problems, taking advantage of iterative smoothing via the Moreau envelope followed by one Frank-Wolfe step per iteration. The problem template we consider encompasses splitting problems with multiple convex constraint sets as well as problems with nonsmooth weakly convex regularizers like the MCP or SCAD penalties.
